profile: Senior Software Engineer with 5 years building high-scale commerce and growth systems at LinkedIn — with expertise spanning APIs, relational databases, stream processing, and batch processing.

accomplishments: Led the design and implementation of a payment-failure alerting platform with near-real-time invoice tracking that recovered $2M+ annually while operating at 100K read QPS from LinkedIn Feed.
Extended the payment-failure alerting platform with usage-billing and win-back cancellation-reminder functionality as platform-attributed annual revenue grew from $2M to $8M.
Built a reusable Database cutover library adopted by 10 domain teams for MySQL Migration, using shadow reads, rollback hooks, and TTL-based entity routing to preserve read-after-write consistency.
Led the 12 TB, 20B-row Ordering migration from Oracle to MySQL, rewriting 30K+ lines of Java & SQL across ~75 PRs while achieving zero downtime and data loss.
Designed and shipped shared optimistic locking across every MySQL update path, surfacing conflicts before Temporal retries could silently overwrite concurrent writes.
Built a batch deletion pipeline that safely purged 300K corrupt production orders, then scaled it to purge ~6B dormant orders from a 10+ year-old database.
Replaced N+1 read patterns with batched MySQL queries across Ordering workflows, reducing average latency from 50 to 30 ms and p95 from 200 to 125 ms.
Built the video-resolution and Feed integration for a course recommendation service, then scaled it to 3,000 QPS and increased weekly learners 2.5%.
Designed Spark pipelines that classified 10M+ job seekers across ~50 TB and 20+ datasets per run, expanding personalized alerts to 22M members.
Scoped and ran an experiment filtering audio-only course recommendations from LinkedIn Feed, increasing engagement 0.2% across hundreds of millions of daily impressions.
